summary: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney and adds a currency parameter that formats amounts with Intl.NumberFormat. It also updates invoiceLines to pass a currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice is still imported by cart.ts
findings.problem: This change removes formatPrice from money.ts and replaces it with formatMoney. However, src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice on line 1 and calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript compile fails because money.ts no longer exports formatPrice. At runtime, cartTotal would throw because formatPrice is undefined.
findings.fix: Update cartTotal in src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney with USD. Or keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: This change makes formatMoney take a currency and format with Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators. No test in the repository covers formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the broken cart.ts import. No test checks the new output format for each currency.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines that cover USD, a second currency and amounts above one thousand.
